answer: A hostile operator running 100 aliases therefore needs 125 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in ember, expire in tide, and haven lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Each duplicate costs another 180 dollars in locked collateral and another 11 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
